primary_meaning: Exalted angelic beings (specifically cherubim) that continually surround God's throne, declaring His holiness and representing the apex of animate creation in worship.

alternatives.meaning: The Four Evangelists (Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John) and their respective Gospels, known as the Tetramorph.
The fourfold nature of Christ or His primary attributes (Kingship/Lion, Servanthood/Ox, Incarnation/Man, Deity/Eagle).
Representatives of all living creatures on earth (wild animals, domesticated animals, humanity, and birds) praising the Creator.

notes: While modern biblical scholarship generally agrees that the living creatures represent angelic throne guardians (cherubim) and the whole of creation worshipping God, patristic and medieval Christian tradition heavily popularized them as symbols of the Four Evangelists, which remains highly visible in church iconography.
